picks.matchup: New England Patriots vs Buffalo Bills
picks.analysis: The Bills have a solid home advantage and a strong team. Expect them to cover the spread against a struggling Patriots team.

picks.matchup: Tennessee Titans vs New York Jets
picks.analysis: The Titans have shown promise in their preseason games, and they are facing a Jets team that has been inconsistent. Look for the Titans to pull off the upset.
Both teams have powerful offenses that have a high likelihood of scoring. Expect a shootout that goes over the total.
